default.description: Default capabilities for the main window. `core:webview:allow-create-webview-window` is scoped to `main` only — the child `network-viz` window inherits the more restrictive `network-viz` capability (see network-viz.json) and cannot spawn further windows.

network-viz.description: Capabilities for the network visualization child window. Intentionally omits `core:webview:allow-create-webview-window` (least privilege) — only the `main` window is allowed to spawn child windows.
